author: RPG-Engine

commands.name: New game
commands.description: Create a fresh RPGEngine world and character (procedural overworld with towns, dungeons, shrines and the Tower of Ascension).

defaultParameters.name: seed
defaultParameters.description: World seed. -1 picks a random seed.

defaultParameters.name: playerName
defaultParameters.description: Name of the player character.

defaultParameters.name: classId
defaultParameters.description: Class id: warrior, ranger, mage, cleric, rogue, paladin, bard or dw-hero.

defaultParameters.name: mode
defaultParameters.description: Game mode: classic or dw (Dragon Warrior / Alefgard).

commands.name: Save game
commands.description: Save the current RPGEngine game to a slot (stored in browser localStorage).

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: Save slot name.

commands.name: Start Dragon Warrior
commands.description: Start the complete Dragon Warrior / Alefgard campaign using the RPGEngine bridge.

defaultParameters.name: playerName
defaultParameters.description: Name of the heir of Erdrick.

defaultParameters.name: seed
defaultParameters.description: World seed. -1 uses the fixed Alefgard layout.

commands.name: Load game
commands.description: Load an RPGEngine game from a slot.

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: Save slot name.

commands.name: Delete slot
commands.description: Permanently delete an RPGEngine save slot.

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: Save slot name.

commands.name: Slot exists?
commands.description: Store 1 in a variable if the save slot exists, 0 otherwise.

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: Save slot name.

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store the result.

commands.name: Move
commands.description: Move the engine hero one tile. Wild encounters are resolved automatically as battles.

defaultParameters.name: direction
defaultParameters.description: Direction: north, south, east or west.

commands.name: Position to variables
commands.description: Store the engine hero's current tile coordinates into two variables.

defaultParameters.name: xVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for the X coordinate.

defaultParameters.name: yVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for the Y coordinate.

commands.name: Enter dungeon
commands.description: Enter the procedural dungeon at the given feature index (0 = first dungeon).

defaultParameters.name: dungeonIndex
defaultParameters.description: Index of the dungeon feature to enter (0-based).

commands.name: Enter tower
commands.description: Enter the 100-floor Tower of Ascension (sealed until level 10).

commands.name: Descend stairs
commands.description: Descend to the next dungeon floor.

commands.name: Ascend stairs
commands.description: Ascend to the previous dungeon floor (or exit to the surface on floor 1).

commands.name: Tower next floor
commands.description: Climb to the next tower floor.

commands.name: Tower prev floor
commands.description: Descend to the previous tower floor (or exit on floor 1).

commands.name: Interact
commands.description: Interact with the current tile: open chests, pray at shrines, talk to towns.

commands.name: Generate world
commands.description: Regenerate the procedural overworld with the given feature counts.

defaultParameters.name: seed
defaultParameters.description: World seed. -1 picks a random seed.

defaultParameters.name: townCount
defaultParameters.description: Number of towns.

defaultParameters.name: dungeonCount
defaultParameters.description: Number of dungeons.

defaultParameters.name: towerCount
defaultParameters.description: Number of towers.

defaultParameters.name: shrineCount
defaultParameters.description: Number of shrines.

commands.name: Run battle
commands.description: Run an automatic battle against the given enemies. Results are stored in variables.

defaultParameters.name: enemies
defaultParameters.description: Comma-separated enemy ids, e.g. rat, goblin.

defaultParameters.name: victoryVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for the result (1 = victory, 0 = defeat/fled).

defaultParameters.name: xpVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for XP earned.

defaultParameters.name: goldVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for gold earned.

commands.name: Add XP
commands.description: Add experience points to the player and handle level ups and milestones.

defaultParameters.name: amount
defaultParameters.description: Amount of XP to add.

commands.name: Learn skill
commands.description: Teach the player a skill (if they meet the requirements).

defaultParameters.name: skillId
defaultParameters.description: Skill id, e.g. power-strike, fireball, heal, backstab.

commands.name: Spend stat point
commands.description: Spend one stat point on a stat.

defaultParameters.name: stat
defaultParameters.description: Stat: strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, charisma or luck.

commands.name: Status to variables
commands.description: Store HP, max HP, MP, max MP, level, gold, XP and stat points into eight variables.

defaultParameters.name: hpVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for HP.

defaultParameters.name: maxHpVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for max HP.

defaultParameters.name: mpVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for MP.

defaultParameters.name: maxMpVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for max MP.

defaultParameters.name: levelVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for level.

defaultParameters.name: goldVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for gold.

defaultParameters.name: xpVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for XP.

defaultParameters.name: statPointsVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID for unspent stat points.

commands.name: Give item
commands.description: Give items to the player's inventory.

defaultParameters.name: itemId
defaultParameters.description: Item id, e.g. healing-potion, iron-sword, chainmail, torch, ration.

defaultParameters.name: count
defaultParameters.description: Number of items to give.

commands.name: Remove item
commands.description: Remove items from the player's inventory.

defaultParameters.name: itemId
defaultParameters.description: Item id to remove.

defaultParameters.name: count
defaultParameters.description: Number of items to remove.

commands.name: Use item
commands.description: Use a consumable item (heals, cures, or DW-mode items like torch, fairy water, wing).

defaultParameters.name: itemId
defaultParameters.description: Item id to use.

commands.name: Item count to variable
commands.description: Store how many of an item the player has into a variable.

defaultParameters.name: itemId
defaultParameters.description: Item id to count.

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store the count.

commands.name: Craft
commands.description: Craft an item from a recipe at a station.

defaultParameters.name: recipeId
defaultParameters.description: Recipe id, e.g. craft-healing-potion, forge-iron-sword, cook-ration.

defaultParameters.name: station
defaultParameters.description: Station: forge, campfire or alchemy.

commands.name: Equip item
commands.description: Equip an item from the inventory on the correct slot.

defaultParameters.name: itemId
defaultParameters.description: Item id to equip, e.g. iron-sword, chainmail.

commands.name: Unequip
commands.description: Unequip the item in the given slot.

defaultParameters.name: slot
defaultParameters.description: Slot: weapon, shield, armor, helmet, accessory or offhand.

commands.name: Buy
commands.description: Buy an item from an NPC shop (requires the NPC to sell it).

defaultParameters.name: itemId
defaultParameters.description: Item id to buy.

defaultParameters.name: npcId
defaultParameters.description: NPC id, e.g. merchant, blacksmith, alchemist.

commands.name: Sell
commands.description: Sell items from the inventory for gold.

defaultParameters.name: itemId
defaultParameters.description: Item id to sell.

defaultParameters.name: count
defaultParameters.description: Maximum number to sell.

commands.name: Start quest
commands.description: Start a quest in the engine quest log.

defaultParameters.name: questId
defaultParameters.description: Quest id, e.g. q-rat-menace, q-dungeon-clear, q-ancient-relic.

commands.name: Complete quest
commands.description: Complete a quest (grants its rewards).

defaultParameters.name: questId
defaultParameters.description: Quest id to complete.

commands.name: Quest active?
commands.description: Store 1 in a variable if the quest is active, 0 otherwise.

defaultParameters.name: questId
defaultParameters.description: Quest id to check.

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store the result.

commands.name: Quest completed?
commands.description: Store 1 in a variable if the quest is completed, 0 otherwise.

defaultParameters.name: questId
defaultParameters.description: Quest id to check.

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store the result.

commands.name: Talk to NPC
commands.description: Start a dialog with an NPC (opens the engine dialog tree).

defaultParameters.name: npcId
defaultParameters.description: NPC id, e.g. elder, blacksmith, merchant, hunter.

commands.name: Choose dialog option
commands.description: Pick a dialog option by index (0 = first option).

defaultParameters.name: optionIndex
defaultParameters.description: Index of the dialog option to choose.

commands.name: Close dialog
commands.description: Close the current dialog.

commands.name: Dialog text to variable
commands.description: Store the current dialog text into a variable.

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store the dialog text.

commands.name: Last message to variable
commands.description: Store the last engine message into a variable.

defaultParameters.name: variable
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store the message.

commands.name: Run trial
commands.description: Run a level-gated trial challenge.

defaultParameters.name: trialId
defaultParameters.description: Trial id: trial-fire, trial-shadow, trial-storm, trial-moon, trial-undead.

defaultParameters.name: successVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store success (1 = cleared).

commands.name: Run raid
commands.description: Run a multi-stage raid gauntlet (consumes a raid-whistle).

defaultParameters.name: raidId
defaultParameters.description: Raid id: raid-colossus, raid-warlord, raid-dragon-king, raid-void-tyrant.

defaultParameters.name: successVar
defaultParameters.description: Variable ID to store success (1 = cleared).

defaultParameters.name: Save prefix
defaultParameters.description: Prefix used to namespace saves in localStorage (change per project).

defaultParameters.name: Log to console
defaultParameters.description: Log engine messages and battles to the browser console.

description: Brings the rpg-engine into RPG Paper Maker: a procedural overworld and dungeon generator, turn-based battles, character stats and XP/leveling, inventory and crafting, quest log, NPC dialog trees, the 100-floor Tower of Ascension, trials and raids, Dragon Warrior mode, and save/load. All systems are driven by event commands. The engine state lives in localStorage (namespaced by the Save prefix parameter).
name: RPGEngine

parameters.name: Save prefix
parameters.description: Prefix used to namespace saves in localStorage (change per project).

parameters.name: Log to console
parameters.description: Log engine messages and battles to the browser console.
